name: De Bogaartjes
overview: They run seventeen restaurants, have six adult children, four grandchildren, a full-fledged petting zoo, and sixteen dogs: meet the flamboyant Bogaart family. This successful hospitality family, known from the NPO program "Where Do They Live From?", opens its doors and takes viewers into their turbulent lives every week, where entrepreneurship, chaos, love, and alpacas alternate at breakneck speed.
